description: The compositor's support of documented Painter symbols (phase1.14_compositor-core item 2.8, decision 081): every Phase 1 node kind, source, projection, sampling mode and blend mode in the operation context `compositor` (or a narrower `compositor:<case>`), `supported` with the Tier 0 goldens of the current oracle envelope that it reproduces exactly, or `release-gap` naming its owner task. The `any` context of the inventory (the Python API symbol) stays a release gap until the API tasks prove it. Input of generate_capabilities.py; see tools/capabilities/README.md.

entries.notes: OCIO with Painter's substance config (decision 190): uniform colours (sRGB, unset, Raw), an 8-bit colour bitmap in sRGB or Raw on an sRGB8 channel at 1:1 and a 16-bit grey mask source at 1:1 evaluate, and the export writes PNG 16, PNG 8, OpenEXR 32f and $colorSpace as Painter does: every map of export-ocio-encode byte-identical (r1, and r2 where stable).

8- and 16-bit PNG bitmaps bound by content hash; in the Raw, Data, DataSigned and NormalXYZLeft colour spaces a code c is float32(c / M) stored with the channel's write rule; on Height 2t - 1.

A bitmap on the Normal channel of a DirectX project is stored as in an OpenGL project (green inverted, 8 and 16 bits); supported as one bitmap fill in Normal mode at opacity 1 without mask or effects, the recorded case; any other DirectX Normal stack is refused (phase1.12_compositor-height-normal, decision 079).

Raw, Data, DataSigned and NormalXYZLeft read a code c as float32(c / M), and so do Working and Legacy Linear; sRGB (Painter's default for a colour bitmap on BaseColor) and Legacy sRGB decode each texel to float32 (8-bit: the GPU's sRGB8 decode; 16-bit: its float32 shader decode) before the projection samples it, onto an sRGB8 channel: exact for 8- and 16-bit colour and grey bitmaps at 1:1, magnified by a bilinear filter and under Nearest at any scale, and for 16-bit bitmaps minified by BilinearHQ and BilinearSharp through the texture unit on the decoded float32 mip chain, in the domain of compositor:minification (decision 203). Painter refuses sRGB on every other channel format and on a mask source (ValueError "Invalid colorspace 'standard sRGB'", the bitmap stays Data), and so does the facade (decision 174; src/evaluator/sources.h).

Bilinear minification of an 8-bit sRGB bitmap (BilinearHQ or BilinearSharp over a footprint above one texel) is refused: Painter samples an sRGB8 texture, whose mip levels hold sRGB8 codes and whose filter is not the float32 texture's (srgb-bitmap-minification s0-s3, measured on the recording GPU; decision 203). It needs a texture-unit replica for sRGB8 textures (phase1.15_compositor-colour-fits item 2.5).
